dogecoin.text: So back in January I thought I'd dip my to in the cryptocurrency scene and I bought a measly amount of #Dogecoin. Needless to say, I'm glad I did. If it weren't for #Covid19 restrictions I'd cash out and spend a couple weeks on an island somewhere.
@crandallgold I know my Dogecoin lost a shit ton of its value. I wish there was a way to invest in Eddie Murphy on SNL because those shows were fucking gold.
